name: tiktok-studio-publish
title: TikTok Studio Video Publisher
job_to_be_done: Upload and schedule prepared vertical educational videos to a confirmed TikTok Studio account.

trigger_surface.description: Use when the user asks to upload or schedule prepared MP4 videos in a user-confirmed TikTok Studio account, set Vietnamese captions and hashtags, add or rotate TikTok platform music at low volume while preserving original audio, or audit post rows. Do not trigger for video generation/editing, analytics-only work, deleting posts, or an unconfirmed browser/account.
should_trigger: Upload these prepared MP4s to my confirmed TikTok Studio account and schedule them with different low-volume platform songs.
把这些短视频上传到我确认的 TikTok Studio，设置越南语说明、话题，并轮换背景音乐后定时发布。
Verify each scheduled TikTok post row and record the music track and volume used.
Use the TikTok Studio workflow to schedule the next batch, but keep the original audio unchanged.
should_not_trigger: Analyze the views and watch time of my TikTok posts only.
Generate the teaching videos and make the subtitles more attractive.
Delete the old TikTok videos and clean up the account.
Explain how TikTok scheduling works; do not upload anything.
用同一首音乐做完整批次，但不要发布。
Do not edit videos, generate media, choose an unconfirmed browser/account, or delete existing posts.
